backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles, roles, admin allowlist checks, signup flows, and system reset logic using AccessControl mixin with in‑memory maps for users and reports.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a deployment promotion task, listing involved files, components, and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for reference or documentation.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide explaining how to package the PWA as an Android Trusted Web Activity using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for running the app on the Internet Computer, covering local development, mainnet deployment, upgrades, and post‑deploy tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH‑based color variables for light and dark themes with global utility setup.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the app root, manifest, icons, and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, start URL, theme colors, and 192x192 and 512x512 icon assets.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker managing versioned precache, runtime caching, skip-waiting, and network-first/static-first fetch behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router and authentication flow handling identity state, profile loading, errors, and conditional rendering of screens.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI card notifying users they lack admin permissions with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with branding, navigation, user info, clipboard actions, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App shell providing header, footer, banners, and container layout around page content.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login/signup UI for Internet Identity with stale-session recovery and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Displays an offline warning banner when network connectivity is lost.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User profile creation form handling validation, engineer/admin roles, and signup mutations.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Banner notifying users of a new service worker version with an option to apply the update.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session-expired screen with an explanation and a logout button that triggers a full logout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine that clears identity, caches, session storage, and reloads the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Offers a hook to capture browser geolocation with timeout handling and optional auto-capture.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a provider and hook for managing Internet Identity login, state, and stored delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline status using browser events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, signups, admin checks, and related backend interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and provides a manual apply function to activate the new version.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and industrial-style color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin page that lists users, supports deleting users, purging legacy data, resetting the app, and checking admin access.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single service report with customer, machine, and status details, including loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating a new service report with validation and submission to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows report history with search, filtering, CSV download, and optional user-based filtering.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Helpers to detect missing profiles and distinguish real authentication errors from non-auth failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears Internet Identity and auth-related data from storage to ensure a clean logout.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates and exposes a build/version identifier for cache invalidation and UI display.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Utility to copy text to the clipboard with a fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utilities to format principal IDs and usernames for display.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all service worker caches during system reset, swallowing errors for compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts daily service reports to CSV and triggers a file download with a timestamped filename.
Extracts, sanitizes, and translates backend signup errors into user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized logging and error scrubbing utilities for the signup/profile flow.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates required fields, email format, and mobile number rules for signup forms.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter parsing, session persistence, and safe cleanup of sensitive hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s metadata, current state, and existing features for build tracking.
